ministries.d: Frames national policy on crops, farm inputs, credit and crop insurance, and runs farmer-income schemes such as PM-KISAN and PM Fasal Bima Yojana. Its Department of Agricultural Research and Education oversees ICAR.

Promotes and regulates the traditional systems of medicine: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa and Homoeopathy. It covers their education, research, drug standards and the National AYUSH Mission.

Covers chemicals and petrochemicals, fertilizers and pharmaceuticals through three departments. It secures fertilizer supply and subsidy for farmers and runs the Jan Aushadhi network of low-cost generic medicine stores.
Regulates and develops air transport: airports, airlines and air safety through the DGCA, and regional air connectivity under the UDAN scheme.
Sets policy for exploring, allocating and mining coal and lignite, including commercial coal-block auctions, and oversees Coal India Ltd and NLC India.
Runs foreign trade policy and trade negotiations through the Department of Commerce, and industrial policy, investment promotion and Startup India through DPIIT.
Oversees telecommunications, spectrum and broadband through the Department of Telecommunications, and India Post through the Department of Posts.

ministries.n: Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministries.d: Protects consumer rights and product standards (BIS, consumer commissions) and manages food-grain procurement, storage and the public distribution system, including free grain under PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana.
Created in 2021 to strengthen the cooperative movement. It administers multi-state cooperative societies, is computerising primary agricultural credit societies and promotes cooperative-led growth.
Administers the Companies Act, the LLP Act and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, regulating company registration, governance and filings through the Registrars of Companies.
Preserves India's tangible and intangible heritage and promotes the arts through the Archaeological Survey of India, national museums, academies, libraries and archives.
Responsible for national defence and the armed forces: the Army, Navy and Air Force, defence production and exports, research through DRDO, and the welfare of ex-servicemen.
Coordinates development of the eight north-eastern states, funding infrastructure and livelihood projects and working with the North Eastern Council.
Provides weather, climate, ocean and earthquake services through IMD, INCOIS and the National Centre for Seismology, and runs polar and deep-ocean research.
Shapes national education policy (NEP 2020) through the Departments of School Education & Literacy and Higher Education, overseeing bodies such as UGC, NCERT, the IITs and central universities.
Drives Digital India: electronics and semiconductor manufacturing, IT and IT-enabled services, cybersecurity through CERT-In, Aadhaar through UIDAI, and data-protection rules.
Plans and enforces environmental and forest conservation, wildlife protection and pollution control, and leads India's climate-change commitments.
Conducts India's foreign relations and diplomacy, runs embassies and missions abroad, and provides passport, visa and consular services.
Manages the economy and public finances: the Union Budget, direct and indirect taxes, expenditure, banking and financial services, and public-sector enterprises through DIPAM and DPE.
Develops fisheries, livestock and dairy through separate departments, including animal-health programmes, the National Gokul Mission and PM Matsya Sampada Yojana.
Promotes the food-processing industry with mega food parks, cold chains and the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme, to cut wastage and raise farm incomes.
Runs national health policy and programmes: Ayushman Bharat, disease control, immunisation, medical education and AIIMS, and health research through ICMR.
Oversees the capital-goods and automotive industries and heavy-engineering public-sector units, and runs electric-mobility programmes such as PM E-DRIVE and the auto PLI scheme.
Handles internal security, border management, the central armed police forces, disaster management, centre-state relations and the administration of Union Territories.
Sets urban development policy and runs the Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT, Swachh Bharat (Urban), PMAY-Urban housing and metro rail projects.
Regulates broadcasting, films and the press, and runs public-service media: Prasar Bharati (Doordarshan and All India Radio) and the Press Information Bureau.
Manages India's water resources through two departments: river development and water conservation, and drinking water and sanitation, including the Jal Jeevan Mission and Swachh Bharat (Grameen).
Frames labour law, including the four labour codes, provides social security through EPFO and ESIC, and runs employment schemes and the e-Shram registry of unorganised workers.

Advises the government on legal matters (Department of Legal Affairs), drafts central legislation (Legislative Department) and supports judicial infrastructure and access to justice (Department of Justice).

links.xs: Ministry of Law and Justice India

ministries.d: Supports small businesses through credit guarantees, the Udyam registration portal and the PMEGP employment programme, and promotes khadi and village industries through KVIC.
Regulates exploration and mining of minerals other than coal, oil and gas, including critical minerals, through the Geological Survey of India and mineral-block auctions.
Runs education, skilling and economic schemes for the six notified minority communities and oversees the administration of waqf properties.
Leads solar, wind, green hydrogen and bioenergy development, including PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar and India's 500 GW non-fossil capacity target.
Strengthens rural local self-government through gram panchayats, funding capacity building and e-governance, and runs the SVAMITVA scheme for rural property cards.
Manages the government's business in Parliament: scheduling sessions, coordinating bills and floor strategy, and liaising with parties across both Houses.
Manages the civil services: recruitment, training and cadre management (DoPT), administrative reforms and public grievances (DARPG), and central government pensions.
Oversees exploration, production, refining, distribution and marketing of oil and natural gas, and runs clean-cooking programmes such as PM Ujjwala Yojana.
Works with NITI Aayog, the government's policy think tank, on long-term development strategy, programme monitoring and evaluation.
Sets policy for electricity generation, transmission and distribution, grid reliability and energy efficiency, and funds distribution reforms and smart metering.
Runs Indian Railways, one of the world's largest rail networks: passenger and freight services, station redevelopment, Vande Bharat trains and the dedicated freight corridors.
Builds and maintains national highways through NHAI and NHIDCL, and frames motor-vehicle law and road-safety policy.
Runs rural employment and poverty-reduction programmes: the MGNREGA job guarantee, PMAY-Gramin housing, PMGSY rural roads and the DAY-NRLM livelihoods mission.
Funds scientific research and innovation through the Department of Science and Technology, biotechnology through DBT, and industrial research through DSIR and CSIR.
Develops major ports, merchant shipping, shipbuilding and inland waterways, and runs the Sagarmala port-led development programme.
Coordinates skilling nationwide through the Skill India Mission, ITIs and apprenticeships, and promotes entrepreneurship.
Works for Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, senior citizens, persons with disabilities and transgender persons through scholarships, welfare schemes and rights legislation.
Produces official statistics such as GDP, the Consumer Price Index and the Periodic Labour Force Survey, and monitors central schemes and large infrastructure projects.
Plans growth of the steel sector, oversees SAIL, RINL and other steel public-sector units, and promotes domestic capacity and specialty steel.
Supports textiles from fibre to fashion: handlooms, handicrafts, silk, jute and technical textiles, including the PM MITRA mega textile parks.
Promotes India as a destination through Incredible India, develops tourist circuits under Swadesh Darshan and sets hospitality standards.
Leads welfare and development of Scheduled Tribes, including Eklavya Model Residential Schools, scholarships, forest-rights implementation and PM-JANMAN.
Works for the development of women and children: anganwadi services, nutrition under Poshan Abhiyaan, child protection and schemes such as Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
Runs youth programmes such as NSS and MY Bharat, and develops sport through Khelo India and athlete support from the Sports Authority of India.
A department directly under the Prime Minister. It runs India's nuclear power and research programme, including BARC, nuclear fuel and reactor development.
A department directly under the Prime Minister. It runs the space programme through ISRO: launch vehicles, satellites and missions such as Chandrayaan and Gaganyaan.
